# OpenVideo

> OpenVideo is an open-source Video-as-Code platform built for coding agents. A video is a JSON document (the Composition IR); every frame is a pure function of composition, assets, frame and seed. Agents create, validate, render single frames, inspect, patch and render final videos through one API (HTTP, MCP, CLI).

Documentation is written in German; identifiers, JSON keys and error messages are English.

## Start here

- [Agent guide](docs/ai/AGENTS.md): workflow, rules, animation, node types, patches, diagnostics
- [Recipes](docs/guide/recipes.md): small verified IR snippets for common tasks
- [Getting started](docs/guide/getting-started.md): install, create, dev, render
- [Capability manifest](docs/ai/capabilities.json): node types, components, operations, backends, formats (generated)
- Live self-description: the 30 operations include `capabilities.get` and `schema.get`; the MCP server (`openvideo mcp --project <dir>`) also serves `openvideo://agents.md`, `openvideo://schema.json` and `openvideo://capabilities.json`

## Reference

- [JSON Schema of the Composition IR](packages/schema/openvideo.schema.json)
- [Render semantics](docs/reference/node-semantics.md): coordinates, boxes, paint, text, media, 3D
- [Agent API operations](docs/guide/api.md): all 30 operations with input examples and one example per patch kind
- [CLI](docs/guide/cli.md): commands, options, exit codes; `openvideo op <name> --input <json|@file>` runs any operation
- [Architecture](_bmad-output/planning-artifacts/architecture/architecture-agentic-video-engine-2026-09-28/ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.md) and [ADRs](docs/adr/README.md)
- [API reference](docs/api/README.md): TypeScript packages (generated)
